title: Toggle Sneak & Sprint Keybinds
description: Adds keybinds to switch between hold or toggle modes for sneaking and sprinting controls
body:
Adds keybinds to switch between hold or toggle modes for sneaking and sprinting controls.

### Default Keybinds:
- Toggle Sneak Mode: J
- Toggle Sprint Mode: K

![A screenshot showing the two keybinds in Minecraft's options menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4602ba8160a5420830350fdae3161afd9f33548f.png)
